entities.name: Query calreticulin
observations: The 424-residue sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Dictyostelium discoideum calreticulin Q23858.
Predicted molecular weight is 48,364 Da; theoretical pI is 4.63; predicted charge at pH 7 is -37.6.
The N-terminus begins with a strongly hydrophobic signal-peptide-like segment, consistent with entry into the secretory pathway.
The sequence contains two Calreticulin Pfam domain hits spanning residues 23–257 and 260–333.

The C-terminal region is highly acidic and contains a Lys/Glu-rich ER-retention-tail-like segment; exact mature processing and retention motif interpretation should be treated cautiously from sequence alone.

entities.name: Calreticulin Q23858
observations: Reviewed Dictyostelium discoideum calreticulin is an endoplasmic-reticulum lumen calcium-binding molecular chaperone.
It promotes folding, oligomeric assembly, and quality control of glycoproteins through the calreticulin/calnexin cycle.
Associated annotations include calcium ion binding, protein folding, ERAD, and ER localization.

entities.name: ER glycoprotein chaperone
observations: Calreticulin transiently interacts with monoglucosylated glycoproteins in the ER and supports their folding and quality control.
The functional assignment is supported by an exact sequence match to reviewed Q23858 rather than sequence similarity alone.

entities.name: Endoplasmic reticulum lumen
observations: The exact reference protein is annotated to the ER lumen; the query signal-peptide-like N-terminus supports secretory-pathway targeting.
The protein is soluble rather than a multipass membrane protein based on the absence of additional long hydrophobic segments after the N-terminus.
